spec.situation_desc: had their savings interest rate cut without noticing any letter

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Bronwen Kowalski. I’ve just noticed the interest rate on my savings account has been cut, and I never saw any letter about it. I’m really unhappy with the way you’ve handled this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Bronwen. I can see your Everyday Saver has a balance of £12,460.18, and the rate changed from 3.1% to 2.4% on 1 September.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s exactly what I mean. You’ve taken a fair bit off the interest and I wasn’t told.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re upset. Before I go further, can you tell me your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I’ll have a look at the information we have about the rate change. I can’t see a copy of a letter on this screen.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you’ve changed the rate and can’t even show me that you told me. That’s not good enough.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, Bronwen. The account information says the new rate took effect on 1 September, but I can’t confirm from here what was sent or when.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: What are you going to do about it, then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can explain the process. I’ll record the details of your query, and it will be reviewed. You’ll receive a full written response within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And that’s all I can expect? I still think the bank’s treated me badly.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t say what the review will conclude, and I don’t want to give you the wrong impression about the outcome. The next step is that the details are reviewed and a full written response is sent within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to check, I’ve understood that you’re unhappy because the savings rate fell from 3.1% to 2.4% on 1 September and you didn’t notice a letter, and the details will be reviewed with a full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, I understand the process. I’m still not happy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. Is there anything else I can explain about the rate or the response process?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: All right, Bronwen. Thank you for calling Thistle Bank, and I’m sorry this has been frustrating.
